name: Trayage
line: A little order for your Downloads.
description: See the installers, possible duplicates, and older files that have accumulated on your Mac. Review what matters and decide what stays.
note: Free file review. Optional 7-day cleanup trial. Direct download and Mac App Store.

name: StylePort
description: A Safari-first, privacy-first CSS and UserCSS manager for Mac. Install, edit, and manage custom styles, with your settings kept locally.
note: Free and open source. Direct download and Mac App Store for macOS 14+.

name: Drift
description: Turn a highlighted passage, page title, and link into an editable Mastodon draft. Add your thoughts, choose your server, and review the post there.
note: Free and open source. No Mastodon password or API token needed.
